recipes.name: Butter chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
1 teaspoon chili powder (Kashmiri if you have it)
1 teaspoon garam masala, plus 1 teaspoon for the sauce
1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) tomato puree or crushed tomatoes
1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), optional
Basmati rice and naan to serve
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, 1 teaspoon garam masala and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
Melt the rest of the butter and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce smooth, then put it back in the pan.
Stir in the cream, sugar, garam masala, fenugreek and the rest of the salt.
Add the chicken and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Serve with rice and naan.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breast or thigh, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon each garam masala and cumin, paprika and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Marinate for 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Heat the broiler to high. Ask an adult to help.
Lay the chicken on a foil-lined pan and broil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the coriander, chili powder and the rest of the garam masala and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream, the rest of the salt and the chicken and simmer for 8 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Top with cilantro and serve with rice and naan.

recipes.name: Chana masala
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the ground spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken it.
Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice and top with cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Dal tadka
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) yellow lentils (toor dal or moong dal), rinsed
steps: Simmer the lentils, water, turmeric and salt in a pot for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until very soft. Whisk until creamy.
Add the tomato and simmer for 5 minutes. Add water if it's too thick.
Chop the onion and slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
For the tadka, heat the ghee in a small pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the garlic, onion and chili and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden.
Turn off the heat and stir in the chili powder and garam masala.
Pour the tadka over the dal. It sizzles. Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
steps: Boil the spinach for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water. Blend into a smooth puree. Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion, garlic and tomato.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomato, coriander and garam masala and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach puree, salt and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer and cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve with roti or rice.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and ground spices and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower and salt and stir to coat.
Add 1/4 cup of water, cover, and cook on low for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring gently now and then, until tender.
Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) bone-in or boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
2 teaspoons biryani masala or garam masala
2 teaspoons salt, plus more for the rice water
2 cups (400 g) basmati rice, rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
4 whole cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 bay leaves
1/4 cup chopped mint and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 pinch saffron soaked in 3 tablespoons warm milk
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, masala and salt. Marinate for 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Fry the onions in the ghee in a heavy pot over medium heat for 15 minutes, until deep golden. Lift out half for the top.
Add the chicken and marinade to the pot and cook for 15 minutes, until it's nearly cooked.
Boil the rice in lots of salted water with the whole spices for 5 to 6 minutes, until about 70% cooked. Drain.
Spread the mint and cilantro over the chicken, then layer the rice on top.
Drizzle with saffron milk and scatter the saved onions.
Cover tightly with foil and the lid and cook on very low heat for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes, then scoop gently from the bottom so each serving has rice and chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken korma
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
steps: Soak the cashews in the hot water for 15 minutes, then blend into a smooth paste.
Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat with the cardamom and cinnamon for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until soft and light golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken, coriander, cumin, turmeric and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time.
Add the cashew paste and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the cream, garam masala and sugar. Take out the whole spices and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Rajma kidney bean curry
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, pureed, or 1 cup (240 ml) crushed tomatoes
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) kidney beans, drained
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the oil separates.
Add the beans, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.
Stir in the garam masala, top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Keema matar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground lamb, beef or chicken
steps: Chop the onion, chili and tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the meat and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the peas and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro. Serve with roti, pav or rice.

recipes.name: Oven tandoori chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken legs and thighs, skin removed
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
Lemon wedges and sliced onion to serve
steps: Cut 2 to 3 deep slashes in each piece of chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, spices, salt and oil and rub it into the slashes. Wash your hands.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Set the chicken on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, until charred in spots and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve with lemon wedges and onion.

recipes.name: Air fryer paneer tikka
ingredients: 14 oz (400 g) paneer, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 bell pepper, cut in 1 inch squares
1 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
steps: Cut the paneer and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, spices, salt and oil.
Gently coat the paneer and vegetables in it and marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread onto short skewers that fit your air fryer, or just lay the pieces in the basket.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway, until charred at the edges.
Serve with mint chutney and naan.

recipes.name: Egg curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk or water
steps: Hard boil the eggs for 11 minutes, cool in ice water and peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Make 3 shallow slits in each egg so the sauce soaks in.
Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, chili powder and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the coconut milk and eggs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Goan fish curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) firm white fish like cod or tilapia, cut in chunks
1 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
1 tablespoon tamarind paste or lime juice
steps: Rub the fish with turmeric and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Chop the onion and tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the spices for 30 seconds, then the tomato for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind and the rest of the salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Gently add the fish and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until it flakes and is 145°F (63°C). Don't stir too much or it breaks.
Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Matar paneer
steps: Chop the onion and puree the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 7 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until thick.
Add the peas and 1 cup water and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the paneer, cream and garam masala and simmer for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Baingan bharta
steps: Prick the eggplants with a fork. An adult roasts them over a gas flame or under the broiler for 15 to 20 minutes, turning, until black and collapsed.
Cool, peel off the skin and mash the flesh.
Chop the onion, chili and tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mashed eggplant and cook for 8 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro. Serve with roti.

recipes.name: Moong dal khichdi
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal
1 cup (140 g) chopped vegetables like carrot, peas and potato (optional)
Plain yogurt and pickle to serve
steps: Rinse the rice and dal together until the water is clear.
Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the ginger, turmeric and vegetables and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, dal, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and porridge-like. Add hot water if it gets too thick.
Serve with a spoon of ghee, yogurt and pickle. It's a gentle comfort food.

recipes.name: Chickpea coconut curry
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the lime juice.
Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.name: Sambar
ingredients: 3/4 cup (150 g) toor dal (split pigeon peas), rinsed
3 cups (720 ml) water, plus 1 cup for the vegetables
2 cups (280 g) mixed vegetables like carrot, eggplant, pumpkin and drumstick, chopped
steps: Simmer the dal, 3 cups water and turmeric for 30 minutes, until very soft. Mash smooth.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the vegetables, onion and tomato in 1 cup water for 10 minutes, until tender.
Add the tamarind, sambar powder and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the mashed dal and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Heat the oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves, chilies and asafoetida for 10 seconds.
Pour over the sambar and serve with rice, idli or dosa.

recipes.name: Lamb rogan josh
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless lamb shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
4 green cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 bay leaves
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
steps: Chop the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and add the whole spices for 30 seconds.
Add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes. Lift it out.
Cook the onions for 10 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the ground spices and salt, then the yogurt, a spoonful at a time.
Add the lamb and water, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, until very tender.
Stir in the garam masala, take out the whole spices, and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork vindaloo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
1/3 cup (80 ml) apple cider or white vinegar
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder, plus cayenne to taste
steps: Blend the vinegar, garlic, ginger, spices and salt into a paste.
Coat the pork in the paste and marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Chop the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 10 minutes, until golden.
Add the pork and all the marinade and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the brown sugar and water, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 30 minutes, until very tender.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to thicken. Serve with rice. It's spicy, so use less cayenne for kids.

recipes.name: Chicken pad thai
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) flat rice noodles (pad thai noodles)
2 tablespoons tamarind paste, or 3 tablespoons lime juice
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced, or shrimp
4 green onions, cut in 1 inch pieces
steps: Soak the noodles in hot tap water for 20 to 30 minutes, until soft but firm. Drain.
Stir the fish sauce, sugar, tamarind and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Slice the chicken and chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and the garlic for 30 seconds. Push aside, add the last of the oil and scramble the eggs for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until the noodles soak it up.
Add the chicken, bean sprouts and green onions and toss for 1 minute.
Top with peanuts and serve with lime and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Thai green curry
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, thinly sliced
1 cup (100 g) Thai eggplant or zucchini, cut in chunks
1 cup (100 g) green beans, cut in pieces
steps: Slice the chicken and cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes, until the oil starts to separate.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, vegetables, fish sauce, sugar and lime leaves.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the basil and serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Thai red curry
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken breast or thigh, thinly sliced
1 can (8 oz / 225 g) bamboo shoots, drained
steps: Slice the chicken and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 can coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, pepper, bamboo shoots, fish sauce and sugar.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the basil and a squeeze of lime. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Massaman curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in chunks
2 tablespoons tamarind paste or lime juice
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the beef, water and cinnamon, cover and simmer on low for 50 minutes.
Add the potatoes, onion, peanuts and the second can of coconut milk.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and tamarind. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Panang chicken curry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons panang or red curry paste
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
Thai basil and rice to serve
steps: Slice the chicken and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add half the coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, peanut butter, fish sauce, sugar and pepper.
Simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until thick and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Top with lime leaves and basil and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pad kra pao Thai basil chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground chicken or finely chopped thighs
2 tablespoons vegetable oil, plus more for the eggs
2 cups (40 g) holy basil or Thai basil leaves
steps: Chop the garlic, chilies and shallot. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the garlic, chilies and shallot for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left and 165°F (74°C).
Add the sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until wilted.
Fry the eggs in hot oil for 2 minutes, until crispy at the edges. Serve the chicken over rice with an egg on top.

recipes.name: Pad see ew
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) fresh wide rice noodles, or 8 oz (225 g) dried, soaked
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
4 cups (300 g) Chinese broccoli (gai lan) or broccoli, cut in pieces
steps: Separate the fresh noodles, or soak dried ones in hot water until soft. Drain.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauces and sugar.
Slice the chicken and greens. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken and garlic for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Add the greens for 2 minutes. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and scramble the eggs for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss, letting them sit for 30 seconds at a time to char a little.
Add the chicken and greens back and toss for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Thai pineapple fried rice
ingredients: 4 cups (700 g) cold cooked jasmine rice
8 oz (225 g) shrimp or diced chicken
1/2 cup (70 g) frozen peas and carrots
steps: Chop the garlic and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes, until pink. Lift out.
Cook the garlic and onion for 1 minute. Push aside and scramble the eggs for 1 minute.
Add the rice, curry powder, soy sauce and fish sauce and toss for 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple, peas and carrots, shrimp and cashews and toss for 2 minutes, until hot.
Top with green onions. Serve in a hollowed pineapple for fun.

recipes.name: Chicken satay with peanut sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in long strips
1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk, plus 3/4 cup (180 ml) for the sauce
1 tablespoon fish sauce or soy sauce
steps: Mix 1/2 cup coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, sugar and fish sauce and coat the chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Simmer 3/4 cup coconut milk, peanut butter, curry paste, lime juice and honey for 3 minutes, whisking, for the peanut sauce.
Heat the broiler or a grill pan to high. An adult should do this.
Cook the skewers for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until charred and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with peanut sauce, cucumber and rice.

recipes.name: Khao man gai Thai chicken and rice
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
2 inch piece ginger, sliced, plus 1 tablespoon grated for the sauce
4 garlic cloves, smashed, plus 2 chopped for the rice
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon fermented soybean paste or miso, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, grated ginger and 1 chili
steps: Put the chicken, water, sliced ginger, smashed garlic and salt in a pot and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Lift the chicken into ice water for 5 minutes so the skin gets tight, then drain. Keep the broth.
Heat the oil in a pot and cook the chopped garlic for 1 minute. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add 2 1/2 cups of the chicken broth, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Serve the chicken on the rice with cucumber, cilantro, sauce and a bowl of hot broth.

recipes.name: Chicken larb
ingredients: 2 tablespoons uncooked sticky or jasmine rice
1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken broth or water
Lettuce leaves, cucumber and sticky rice to serve
steps: Toast the rice in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden. Grind it to a coarse powder.
Slice the shallots and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the chicken in the broth in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chili flakes.
Add the shallots, green onions, herbs and rice powder and toss.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber and sticky rice.

recipes.name: Thai cashew chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken, cut in bite-size pieces
1 red bell pepper, cut in chunks
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, honey and water.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the onion, pepper, garlic and chilies for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken, sauce and cashews and toss for 1 minute, until glossy.
Add the green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Thit kho caramelized pork and eggs
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork belly or shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
Rice and pickled vegetables to serve
steps: Mix the pork with the fish sauce, garlic and shallots and marinate for 20 minutes. Ask an adult to help cut the pork.
In a heavy pot over medium heat, cook the sugar and water without stirring for 4 to 5 minutes, until dark amber. An adult should do this, caramel is very hot.
Add the pork and stir to coat in the caramel. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut water and enough water to just cover the pork. Bring to a boil and skim.
Cover partly and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes more, until the pork is tender and the sauce is a little thick.
Sprinkle with pepper and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, very finely chopped, or 3 tablespoons lemongrass paste
Rice, cucumber and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the lemongrass, garlic and shallots very finely. Ask an adult to help.
Mix them with the fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce and turmeric and coat the chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until caramelized and 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and chili.

recipes.name: Bo luc lac shaking beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) sirloin or ribeye, cut in 1 inch cubes
Dipping sauce: juice of 1 lime, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper
steps: Cut the beef and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, half the garlic and pepper and coat the beef. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a big pan over high heat until it shimmers.
Add the beef in one layer and let it sear for 1 minute without moving.
Shake the pan to turn the cubes and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until browned outside and pink inside, or longer if you like it more done.
Add the butter, onion and the rest of the garlic and toss for 1 minute.
Serve on watercress and tomato with lime pepper salt for dipping.

recipes.name: Filipino chicken adobo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
1/2 cup (120 ml) white or cane vinegar
steps: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, water, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns and sugar in a pot.
Bring to a boil and don't stir for the first 5 minutes, so the vinegar mellows.
Cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C).
Lift the chicken out and pat dry.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 3 minutes per side. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Boil the sauce for 8 to 10 minutes, until reduced by half.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Filipino sweet spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or pork
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and slice the hot dogs. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti as the package says and drain.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the meat and cook for 8 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the hot dogs, banana ketchup, tomato sauce, sugar and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the spaghetti and pile on the cheese.

recipes.name: Bistek tagalog
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef sirloin, very thinly sliced
1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon or calamansi juice
steps: Slice the beef and onions. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, juice, garlic and pepper and coat the beef. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion rings for 2 minutes, until just soft. Lift out.
Lift the beef from the marinade and brown it in batches for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Lift out.
Add the marinade, water and sugar to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the beef back and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender.
Top with the onion rings and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken afritada
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) water or chicken broth
1 red and 1 green bell pepper, cut in chunks
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken, tomato sauce, water and fish sauce and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the peppers, peas and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Beef rendang
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
6 dried red chilies, soaked, or 2 tablespoons sambal oelek
2 stalks lemongrass, bashed and tied in a knot
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and chilies into a paste. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and fry the paste for 5 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the beef, lemongrass, lime leaves, cinnamon and star anise and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind, sugar and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered on low for 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours, stirring more often near the end, until the sauce is dark, thick and clings to the very tender beef.
Stir in the toasted coconut. Take out the lemongrass and whole spices. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
ingredients: 2 pandan leaves, knotted, or 1 slice ginger
1/2 cup (30 g) fried anchovies (ikan bilis), optional
1/2 cup (120 ml) sambal or chili paste
Fried chicken or chicken curry to serve (optional)
steps: Put the rice, coconut milk, water, salt and pandan in a pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes. Take out the pandan and fluff.
Slice the cucumber and halve the eggs. Ask an adult to help.
Shape a scoop of rice on each plate.
Arrange the eggs, peanuts, anchovies, cucumber and a spoon of sambal around it.
Add fried chicken or curry for a bigger meal.

recipes.name: Thai peanut chicken noodles
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) linguine or rice noodles
1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken breast, thinly sliced
Chopped peanuts, cilantro and green onions
steps: Slice the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles as the package says and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, sriracha, garlic and hot water until smooth.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Add the pepper and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Top with peanuts, cilantro and green onions.
